question: How much completed revenue did our customer Nadia Popesku bring in during 2025, and how many support tickets were opened by that customer in the same year? Give the customer's ID and name with both figures.

sql_attempts.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND o.status = 'completed' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed_revenue_2025, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tickets AS t WHERE t.customer_id = c.customer_id AND t.created_date >= '2025-01-01' AND t.created_date <= '2025-12-31') AS tickets_opened_2025 FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE c.customer_name = 'Nadia Popesku' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name LIMIT 500
